body:
Slice 1 of the §58 arc (working spec: .adlc/specs/58-a-connection-is-a-peer.md; design merged 2026-09-01, PR #517). A NEW CAPABILITY, so Myk's merge; land it as a readable stack (a few hundred lines per PR): S1a the consent page's binding field, provisioning the home container and the target in one act (create-root's declaration, the user seed minted when absent, the refusal text when it cannot be); S1b bindConnection wired at consent with a key minted per (client, user) and a forward-only inbox (seeding scope: author is the key AND timestamp after bindAt); S1c reads scoped to the binding (a per-request materialization over the bound subtree, the shape reads.ts uses for a channel lens); S1d a pre-§58 root write grant confers no standing for connections (greenfield — a connector consented before this section consents again).

DECIDED positions this slice realizes: §58 positions 1 (two levels never bound), 2 (write into its pool; read its subtree), 7 (one home; one key per person; greenfield).

Acceptance criteria (the working spec's 1, 3, 8, and the consent half of 12):
- (a) TWO LEVELS OFF-LIMITS at consent: the page refuses the store root and the home container and binds `ada:journal`, provisioning `ada` and its seed when absent; a user with no containers and no seed completes the flow. Verify: test/server/consent-binding.test.ts.
- (b) READS ARE SCOPED: the bound connection's loam_query of a lens whose rows live in `ada:other` answers as if absent, of `loam.grants` likewise, while `ada:journal` rows answer through the same call. Verify: test/server/read-scope.test.ts.
- (c) ONE HOME, ONE KEY PER PERSON: the inbox pool holds none of a pre-binding id at the bytes; the next write lands in the pool; two users consenting one client hold two keys and neither container gathers the other's work; a pre-§58 root write grant confers no standing at any door. Verify: test/server/consent-exchange.test.ts (the pre-§58 grant's inertness lands with S1d).
- (d) THE STORY RAIL: a real browser walks the consent page from a user with no containers and no seed, through password and binding, to a connected store that files a note into the chosen container. Verify: test/browser/consent-binding.test.ts.

edges.contract: The binding record and the per-(client, user) key: S2 derives register/receive/delegate standing from the binding S1 lands, so S2 can build against S1a's binding shape while S1c/S1d land.

title: §58 S1 — bind at consent: the container is the grant
